searchText: <@!199561711278227457> Hello I think this is not the case for asking in this channel, But I think you are the only person handle `beaconchain explorer`. So I wanted to ask about beacon chain explorer starting. At the moment, I'm in success running beacon chain explorer but has some error like ; ```ERRO[0002] error exporting sync_committees duration=1.115847993s error="error exporting snyc-committee at period 0: error retrieving sync_committees for epoch 10 (state: 320): error-response: {\"code\":400,\"message\":\"BAD_REQUEST: state at epoch 10 is not activated for Altair\",\"stacktraces\":[]}" ``` This error have occurred nil pointer deference and drive to kill application. I'm using your config.yaml on the branch you PR to. If you gave me any advice would be appreciatetd. Clients are geth-lighthouse pair. I think this error cames out because my beacon chain explorer couldn't show epoch 0. But your explorer show clearly. I don't know what is the difference. Ahhh, the config in the PR is just a template. You have to configure it per network you run it on. Altair should be epoch 50 afaik That's why epoch 0 won't come out. OK. I will follow merge-testnets repo. Is that right that follow that repo? FYI, explorer that I ran follows `kiln` testnet. Yea but I don't upload the explorer configs there, I can DM it to you later on 🙂 Thank you so much. If you guide me to set up, would be so much appreciated. I think I have fixed it. But another question is that why my explorer couldn't bring epoch 0. This is genesis time stamp one ? I tried to use one time export. Hope that it will be the answer. its possible delay to 2023? many thanks 6/2023 is good deal for all You're asking or suggesting? I guess is it possible, sure, there's not a set date yet. What do you mean by "good deal for all"? (as in, I understand the words, but how is it a good deal for all) for me and for you Could you elaborate? have you some eth? I'm not sure how that's relevant? If one thinks some outcome is good or bad for people with "some eth", then one can just argue that claim. i know what i say but delay its risky too merge is risky.. all is risky its not like push a botton Well, thus https://blog.ethereum.org/2022/03/14/kiln-merge-testnet/ and similar efforts "all is risky" isn't an argument for any particular timing of The Merge. It's a broad equivocation. i dont know what be doing with eth course when merge date be annoucend when reis up, i will be lucky when no, its no funny This is not the correct place to discuss price speculation on the merge. If you don't have any technical concerns regarding the merge besides saying it's dangerous, please stop posting. Is there a page that documents whar work needs to be completed for the merge to happen, alongside any time estimates? https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/master/Merge/mainnet-readiness.md https://notes.ethereum.org/@timbeiko/kiln-milestones thanks!! Is this list finalized, or do action items get added as time goes on? I'm not a core dev, but from what I observe, action items can get added depending on how the tesnets develop. We are pretty close to finalizing most of it though. https://beaconchain.goerlishadowfork.ethdevops.io there were config issues with it so it isnt up to date right now FWIW, I think teams got tired of our milestone documents and stopped updating them 😅 We are farther along that the tables here would suggest. I mean, to get to M5 we need "Keep the devnet up until The Merge as a testing environment for applications" so it's hard to make any more progress. 🙂
